skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of international trade
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the essence, origin, and benefits of international trade through prominent international trade theories.
Students will be able to apply knowledge of international trade and policy management tools to analyze and solve practical issues.
Students will have the ability to synthesize experience and knowledge about international trade to solve emerging problems.
Students will have the ability to work independently and in teams, applying knowledge of international trade to analyze international trade activities and economic trade linkages in practice.
Students will have the ability to independently improve their level and conduct independent scientific research, identifying and solving practical issues related to international trade.
Students will develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve practical issues in international trade.
Students will develop presentation skills to present and explain real-world phenomena and solutions to practical problems in international trade.
